grouping_principle: Tobacco and nicotine counselling is a Reason for Encounter that requires product-specific use, dependence, quit-history, exposure and life-stage context rather than a single smoking-status response.

coverage_goal: combustible heated electronic cigar pipe smokeless and other product identity
product-conditional amount duration last-use and nicotine-content detail
dependence context prior quit attempts supports response readiness triggers and target timing
home and work secondhand exposure pregnancy postpartum conditions medicines and allergies
acute safety patient concern expected help uncertainty provenance terminology and clinician handoff

definition_of_done: current official NICE WHO CDC Korean counselling and build-time STOM source manifest with refresh metadata
licensed-source boundary records and metadata-only retention where required
atomic product-specific questions with conditional detail collection
routine emergency urgent pregnancy remote dual-use and dataAbsentReason simulations
privacy validator build unit all-simulation mapping ValueSet and Coverage gates pass
constraints: Do not infer nicotine dependence, tobacco-related disease or a cessation-treatment indication.
Do not recommend starting, stopping or changing a medicine during collection.
Preserve official LOINC answer lists and create application-specific extensions separately when required.
Keep generated content unreviewed and research_only until clinical, Korean service and terminology review.
